_doc: T190: 150 NN + 150 LGB mega ensemble. Seeds 1-50: T188v2 original HP. Seeds 51-150: extended HP grid (hidden variants, weight_decay, lr_min, LGB config diversity). Phase2 SPO+ M7 protocol identical. Thresholds inherited from T188v2 (thr_up=0.0003, thr_dn=0.000216, w_lgb=1.5, per_sym_beta unchanged).

horizons._doc: T190 150+150 ensemble. Thresholds: T188v2 DE LOSO optimum (unchanged). w_lgb=1.5, w_nn=1.0.

conformal_wrapper._doc: Inherited from T188v2. beta/sigma unchanged — conformal bands calibrated on local val 442k. OOD fallback: beta=0.16 (mean), sigma=0.0003998317 (mean).

_t190_build.nn_seeds_1_50: T188v2 HP (lr x dropout x batch cycling, hidden=(256,128,64))
_t190_build.lgb_seeds_51_150: 10 new HP configs (max_depth/min_data_in_leaf/min_gain variants), lr in {0.03,0.05,0.1}
_t190_build.phase2_protocol: T170 SPO+ M7, lr=3e-5, lambda_spo=30, 11 epochs fixed
